release_narrative: Wave H pre-v1 desktop-axis static-analysis integration. The first release in which the vendor-companion-app extraction methodology generalizes from the Wave G Android mobile axis to Windows / macOS / Linux desktop application binaries. 3 real-vendor binaries + 1 FP-control binary processed (Hikvision iVMS-4200 + DJI Assistant 2 Mavic + DJI Assistant 2 FPV + FileZilla H2-disambig control). Net BLE = 0 after CP26 §8 semantic-validation audit; the 4 surviving UUID-shaped values all re-class to one of three new CP28(c) identifier_type values. Migration 0023 extends the identifier_type CHECK enum 48 → 51.
